content.text: Perfect! Now let me test the integration by having the Planner Agent create an implementation plan based on the research findings:

input.task: Based on the autonomous AI development research findings, create a detailed 6-month implementation roadmap for transitioning ARIA's current architecture to incorporate the latest 2024-2026 best practices. Focus on: (1) Upgrading to graph-based orchestration, (2) Implementing three-tier memory architecture, (3) Enhancing multi-agent coordination, (4) Adding safe self-modification capabilities, and (5) Establishing comprehensive evaluation metrics. Include specific milestones, resource requirements, risk assessment, and success criteria.
